name: here-now
description: Publish websites, apps, and files to live URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Publish websites and files from any AI agent.
interface.longDescription: here.now lets agents publish websites, apps, and files to live URLs at {slug}.here.now or custom domains. Supports passwords and restricted access, custom domains, analytics, Site Data, proxy routes, and private Drive storage for agent files — see here.now/docs for the full feature set.
